item.question: What does the term $p(y, o, u)$ represent in object detection?
item.answer: The term $p(y, o, u)$ represents the class priors defined as $p(y \mid o, u) \cdot p(o, u)=p(y, u) \cdot p(o, u)$ where $o$ is an object and $u$ is the location inside the image.
